summary: First test run of AquaOps (no auth). Backend: 10 pytest tests, 8 passed. The 2 failures are edge cases: an unescaped regex in search causes a 500, and an invalid date gets accepted. Frontend (1920 desktop + 390 mobile): all requested flows work. Checked: dashboard 6 stat cards match /api/dashboard; emergency pause -> banner + closures=8, resume and per-activity toggles; walk-in booking -> voucher; booking blocked when paused / over capacity; bookings search, filters and detail dialog (waiver/check-in/cancel/restore); check-in lookup and pending count update; manifest roster, empty state, print button; notifications sheet; mobile bottom nav with no horizontal overflow. Found 3 functional bugs: Manifest fetch race, notification unread badge logic, search 500.

minor.issue: Returns 500. q is passed raw into $regex. Fix: re.escape(q.strip()). The frontend Bookings search also throws an unhandled promise rejection because there is no .catch.
date is not validated. 'not-a-date' and past dates are accepted (200). Validate YYYY-MM-DD and require >= today.

Restoring a cancelled booking (-> confirmed) does not re-check batch capacity, so it can overbook. It also allows any transition, e.g. cancelled -> checked_in, or checked_in -> confirmed which silently undoes the check-in.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: changing activity then slot quickly fires 2 requests, and a stale response can overwrite the roster. Reproduced 1 of 4 rapid changes, plus once in the first run: showed Banana 08:00 data while 14:00 was selected. Fix: ignore stale responses via an `ignore` flag / AbortController in the useEffect cleanup.

Unread badge = events.length - seen, but /events is capped at 20. Once 20 events exist and the sheet has been opened, new events never raise the badge again. Track the last-seen created_at/id instead of a count.
Duplicate data-testid: the searched booking card and the same booking in the pending list both render checkin-card-{code} / checkin-btn-{code}.

integration_issues.issue: OpsContext only fetches /activities on mount, with no polling. A pause made from another device/tab does not show up (banner, Front Desk disabled options) until reload. The backend still blocks the booking correctly with a toast.
Dashboard, Bookings, Manifest and CheckIn list fetches have no .catch or loading/error state. errMsg turns 422 array details into '[object Object]'.

issues: 'Cancel booking' runs immediately with no confirmation, unlike Emergency Pause.

action_items: Escape the regex in GET /api/bookings q (re.escape) and add .catch in Bookings.jsx
Fix the Manifest useEffect race (stale-response guard)
Fix the notifications unread logic (track last seen event id/timestamp)
Validate the booking date format and reject past dates in POST /api/bookings
Re-check capacity on restore (cancelled->confirmed) and restrict invalid status transitions
Optional: poll /activities in OpsContext; add a confirm before cancelling a booking; dedupe check-in testids
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: unescaped user regex leads to a 500 and potential ReDoS
server.py: no date validation on BookingCreate.date
server.py: the status endpoint has no state machine or capacity re-check
Frontend fetches lack error states; errMsg does not handle FastAPI 422 detail arrays

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; manifest race + badge logic bugs)

seed_data_creation: None. TEST_ bookings were created and then deleted from MongoDB; all activities resumed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env; pytest /app/backend/tests/test_aquaops_api.py. The module fixture resumes all activities and cancels TEST_ bookings; delete them from MongoDB for full cleanup. Container date is 2026-10-19 IST. Today: 14 seed bookings (1 cancelled).
